Asset type: visual preview of a cozy companion dinner scene, portrait composition.

Shadow design: still a soft translucent warm taupe silhouette cast on the table, a large rounded head (about twice the existing head-to-shoulder ratio), tiny short shoulders and tiny compact upper torso, two very small soft rounded hair tufts on the crown. Gender-neutral to boyish cute chibi silhouette. No facial features, no outline, no colored skin or clothes, no actual human figure. Shadow remains about 12-15% opacity, softly feathered at the edges, aligned near the lower foreground center, subtle enough that the table surface is clearly visible through it. The entire silhouette must stay ON THE TABLETOP; never cross the table edge or spill onto the floor.
CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve the existing image 1 room, all framing, perspective, lighting, peach wall, cabinet, picture frame, sunny diagonal light, chair, existing smiling orange dog in its exact same size and position, table outline and all three food plates and food unchanged. Change ONLY the current foreground human shadow. Keep portrait aspect ratio and the overall scene intact.
Avoid: actual person at the table, extra pet, extra food, text, added watermark, realistic adult-sized shoulders, a solid opaque silhouette, shadow on dog or chair, changes to the room.
